attributes.name: Spellbreaker
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6+3; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6+3. If the check is against a bane that has the Mythic trait, add another 1d10, or 1d20 if you also expend a mythic charge.

Reveal this card when a bane deals Acid, Cold, Electricity, Fire, or Force damage to you before you act; reduce that damage to 0. This counts as playing a spell.
